name: comp-46
blurb: Phone number input with country flag selector.
description: A phone input with an integrated country select dropdown showing country flags. Built with react-phone-number-input library supporting international numbers.
use_when: Global forms that need to accept phone numbers from multiple countries with visual locale feedback.
avoid_when: You need a minimal input or don't need country selection.
a11y: Country select has aria-label. Phone input is linked. Flags display with title. Focus management via z-index.
